name: ICHEB
description: ICHEB is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark within the MEMORIA framework for intangible cultural heritage (ICH), covering 6 tasks and 13 datasets spanning knowledge understanding, classification, generation, and cross-cultural translation. It supports evaluation of ICH-focused large language models tailored for cultural knowledge preservation and transmission.
reputation: A specialized benchmark within the MEMORIA framework that is relevant to cultural heritage NLP, but it appears to be niche and not yet widely used outside that research line.
notes: Part of MEMORIA framework including ICH-specific LLM and instruction dataset; covers diverse cultural domains and over 50 languages.
